digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures and test harness environment
propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixture functions return complete copies of os.environ that expose ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments in long tracebacks via saferepr.

Fixture-returned environment dictionaries containing arbitrary inherited credentials appear in test output only under default long traceback mode, not under --tb=short or when the fixture invocation itself is replaced.
All affected fixture behaviors pass when run under a minimal parent environment (env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin), proving no dependency on arbitrary ambient keys.

Each of the seven fixtures must be refactored to return an allowlisted mutable environment containing only required keys (fake-bin-first PATH, state/path variables, and per-fixture overrides) rather than full os.environ copies.

The fixture-argument environment security oracle test verifies absence of the synthetic sentinel in long tracebacks after the fix, confirms the short-traceback negative control, and becomes RED when the broad dict(os.environ) mutation is reintroduced.
